00119 void BEQBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00120 {
00121  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00122  float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00123  float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00124  float* freqSamples = inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00125  float* controlSamples = inputs[Control].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00126  float* gainSamples = inputs[Gain].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00127  float newFreq = *freqSamples;
00128  float newControl = *controlSamples;
00129  float newGain = *gainSamples;
00130  float y0;
00131  
00132  if((currentFreq != newFreq) || (currentControl != newControl) || (currentGain != newGain))
00133  {    
00134   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00135   {
00136    calculateCoeffs(*freqSamples++, *controlSamples++, *gainSamples++);
00137    
00138    y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00139    *outputSamples++ = (float)(a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2);
00140    y2 = y1; 
00141    y1 = y0;   
00142   }
00143     
00144   currentFreq = *(freqSamples-1);
00145   currentControl = *(controlSamples-1);
00146   currentGain = *(gainSamples-1);
00147  }
00148  else
00149  {  
00150   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00151   {
00152    y0 = *inputSamples++ + b1 * y1 + b2 * y2; 
00153    *outputSamples++ = a0 * y0 + a1 * y1 + a2 * y2;
00154    
00155    y2 = y1; 
00156    y1 = y0;
00157   }
00158  }
00159  
00160  y1 = zap(y1);
00161  y2 = zap(y2);
00162 }

00231 void BLowPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain)
00232 {
00233  (void)gain;
00234  
00235  const float w0 = twoPi * freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00236  const float cos_w0 = cos(w0);
00237  const float sin_w0 = sin(w0);  
00238  const float alpha = sin_w0 * 0.5f * rq;
00239  const float temp1 = 1.f / (1.f + alpha);
00240  const float temp2 = 1.f - cos_w0;
00241  
00242  a0 = (temp2 * 0.5f) * temp1;
00243  a1 = temp2 * temp1;
00244  a2 = a0;
00245  b1 = (2.f * cos_w0) * temp1;
00246  b2 = (1.f - alpha) * -temp1;
00247 }

00252 BLowPass::BLowPass(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq, UGen const& rq) throw()
00253 {
00254  UGen inputs[] = { input, freq, rq };
00255  const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);
00256  initInternal(numInputChannels);
00257    
00258  for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00259  {
00260   BEQBaseUGenInternal* filter = new BLowPassUGenInternal(input, freq, rq);
00261   filter->calculateCoeffs(freq.getValue(i), rq.getValue(i), 1.f);
00262   filter->initValue(input.getValue(i));
00263   internalUGens[i] = filter;
00264  }
00265 }

00296 void BHiPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain)
00297 {
00298  (void)gain; // not used in BHiPass
00299  
00300  BEQ_CALC_TYPE w0 = twoPi * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00301  BEQ_CALC_TYPE cosw0 = cos(w0); 
00302  BEQ_CALC_TYPE i = 1.0 + cosw0; 
00303  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)rq; 
00304  BEQ_CALC_TYPE b0_temp = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha); 
00305  a0 = i * 0.5 * b0_temp; 
00306  a1 = -i * b0_temp; 
00307  a2 = a0; 
00308  b1 = cosw0 * 2.0 * b0_temp; 
00309  b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0_temp; 
00310 }

00356 void BBandPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float bw, const float gain)
00357 {
00358  (void)gain; // not used in BBandPass
00359  
00360  BEQ_CALC_TYPE w0 = twoPi * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00361  BEQ_CALC_TYPE sinw0 = sin(w0);
00362  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alpha = sinw0 * (sinh((logSqrt2 * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)bw * w0) / sinw0));
00363  BEQ_CALC_TYPE b0_temp = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha); 
00364  a0 = alpha * b0_temp; 
00365  a1 = 0.0;
00366  a2 = -a0; 
00367  b1 = cos(w0) * 2.0 * b0_temp; 
00368  b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0_temp; 
00369 }

00398 void BBandStopUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float bw, const float gain)
00399 {
00400  (void)gain; // not used in BBandStop
00401  
00402  BEQ_CALC_TYPE w0 = twoPi * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00403  BEQ_CALC_TYPE sinw0 = sin(w0);
00404  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alpha = sinw0 * (sinh((logSqrt2 * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)bw * w0) / sinw0));
00405  BEQ_CALC_TYPE b0_temp = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);  
00406  b1 = 2.0 * b0_temp * cos(w0); 
00407  a0 = b0_temp; 
00408  a1 = -b1;
00409  a2 = b0_temp; 
00410  b2 = (1.0 - alpha) * -b0_temp; 
00411 }

00441 void BPeakEQUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain)
00442 { 
00443  BEQ_CALC_TYPE a = pow(10., (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)gain * (1.0 / 40.0));
00444  BEQ_CALC_TYPE w0 = twoPi * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00445  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)rq;
00446  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alphaBy_a = alpha * a;
00447  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alphaOver_a = alpha / a;
00448  BEQ_CALC_TYPE b0_temp = 1.0 / (1.0 + alphaOver_a); 
00449  b1 = 2.0 * b0_temp * cos(w0); 
00450  a0 = (1.0 + alphaBy_a) * b0_temp; 
00451  a1 = -b1;
00452  a2 = (1.0 - alphaBy_a) * b0_temp; 
00453  b2 = (1.0 - alphaOver_a) * -b0_temp; 
00454 }

00484 void BLowShelfUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rs, const float gain)
00485 { 
00486  BEQ_CALC_TYPE a = pow(10., (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)gain * (1.0 / 40.0));
00487  BEQ_CALC_TYPE w0 = twoPi * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00488  BEQ_CALC_TYPE sinw0 = sin(w0);
00489  BEQ_CALC_TYPE cosw0 = cos(w0);
00490  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alpha = sinw0 * 0.5 * sqrt((a + (1.0/a)) * ((BEQ_CALC_TYPE)rs - 1.0) + 2.0);
00491  BEQ_CALC_TYPE aPlus1 = a + 1.0;
00492  BEQ_CALC_TYPE aMinus1 = a - 1.0;
00493  BEQ_CALC_TYPE i = aPlus1 * cosw0;
00494  BEQ_CALC_TYPE j = aMinus1 * cosw0;
00495  BEQ_CALC_TYPE k = 2.0 * sqrt(a) * alpha;
00496  BEQ_CALC_TYPE aPlus1Minusk = aPlus1 - k;
00497  BEQ_CALC_TYPE b0_temp = 1.0 / (aPlus1 + j + k); 
00498  
00499  a0 = a * (aPlus1 - j + k) * b0_temp;
00500  a1 = 2.0 * a * (aMinus1 - i) * b0_temp;
00501  a2 = a * (aPlus1Minusk - j) * b0_temp;
00502  b1 = 2.0 * (aMinus1 + i) * b0_temp;
00503  b2 = (aPlus1Minusk + j) * -b0_temp; 
00504 }

00506 BLowShelf::BLowShelf(UGen const& input, UGen const& freq, UGen const& rs, UGen const& gain) throw()
00507 {
00508  UGen inputs[] = { input, freq, rs, gain };

00534 void BHiShelfUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rs, const float gain)
00535 { 
00536  BEQ_CALC_TYPE a = pow(10., (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)gain * 0.025);
00537  BEQ_CALC_TYPE w0 = twoPi * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00538  BEQ_CALC_TYPE sinw0 = sin(w0);
00539  BEQ_CALC_TYPE cosw0 = cos(w0);
00540  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alpha = sinw0 * 0.5 * sqrt((a + (1.0/a)) * ((BEQ_CALC_TYPE)rs - 1.0) + 2.0);
00541  BEQ_CALC_TYPE aPlus1 = a + 1.0;
00542  BEQ_CALC_TYPE aMinus1 = a - 1.0;
00543  BEQ_CALC_TYPE i = aPlus1 * cosw0;
00544  BEQ_CALC_TYPE j = aMinus1 * cosw0;
00545  BEQ_CALC_TYPE k = 2.0 * sqrt(a) * alpha;
00546  BEQ_CALC_TYPE aPlus1Minusk = aPlus1 - k;
00547  BEQ_CALC_TYPE b0_temp = 1.0 / (aPlus1 - j + k); 
00548  
00549  a0 = a * (aPlus1 + j + k) * b0_temp;
00550  a1 = -2.0 * a * (aMinus1 + i) * b0_temp;
00551  a2 = a * (aPlus1Minusk + j) * b0_temp;
00552  b1 = -2.0 * (aMinus1 - i) * b0_temp;
00553  b2 = (aPlus1Minusk - j) * -b0_temp; 
00554 }

00583 void BAllPassUGenInternal::calculateCoeffs(const float freq, const float rq, const float gain)
00584 {
00585  (void)gain; // not used in BAllPass
00586  
00587  BEQ_CALC_TYPE w0 = twoPi * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)freq * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate(); 
00588  BEQ_CALC_TYPE alpha = sin(w0) * 0.5 * (BEQ_CALC_TYPE)rq; 
00589  BEQ_CALC_TYPE b0_temp = 1.0 / (1.0 + alpha);  
00590  b1 = 2.0 * b0_temp * cos(w0); 
00591  a0 = (1.0 - alpha) * b0_temp; 
00592  a1 = -b1;
00593  a2 = 1.0; 
00594  b2 = -a0; 
00595 }
